preconditions.description: The number of routers n must be between 2 and 200000 inclusive.
The input must contain exactly n-1 integers representing parent connections.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p[i] < i + 2 for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: Each parent index p_i must satisfy 1 ≤ p_i < i+1 (1-based indexing).

postconditions.description: The output must be a space-separated sequence of distinct router indices starting with 1 and ending with n.
The path must start with router 1 and end with router n.
All routers in the path must be distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(str(path[i]) == str(path[i+1]) or int(path[i+1]) == p[int(path[i]) - 1] for i in range(len(path) - 1))
postconditions.description: Each consecutive pair in the path must be either the same router (invalid) or a valid parent-child connection (p_i points to the next router in the path).
